description: Defines structures, types, and function prototypes for generic network connection handling in Zephyr OS, including connection registration, unregistration, input processing, and iteration over connections.

methods.name: net_conn_register
methods.description: Registers a callback for incoming network packets matching specified criteria.

methods.name: net_conn_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered connection handler.

methods.name: net_conn_update
methods.description: Updates the callback, user data, remote address, and port for a registered connection handle.

methods.name: net_conn_input
methods.description: Processes an incoming network packet, returning verdicts indicating whether the packet was consumed or dropped.

methods.name: net_conn_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all registered network connection handlers, calling a user-defined callback.

methods.name: net_conn_init
methods.description: Initializes the network connection subsystem (if enabled).
